final_text:
Mycobacterium is not supported in this sample. The whole Mycobacterium genus has only 6 clade reads in `data/spike_H0.report.gz`, split between two species:

| Rank | Taxid | Name | Clade reads |
|---|---|---|---|
| G | 1763 | Mycobacterium | 6 |
| S | 886343 | Mycobacterium spongiae | 3 |
| G1 | 77643 | M. tuberculosis complex | 3 |
| S | 78331 | Mycobacterium canetti | 3 |

The two species account for all 6 genus reads, so no other Mycobacterium species is present. The largest species count is 3 clade reads, well below your 10-read threshold for a credible species call. Even the whole genus (6) falls short of it. A few stray reads like this in a human-only sample are typical misclassification noise, not evidence of a real Mycobacterium. I read the report directly; I didn't need `mockcheck` for this.
